from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, difflib, datetime

B = Path('/workspace/scratch/bfccb8494ba0/cold044-original-intake')
I = B / 'increment-final-53'
O = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = '044c008c9459cfa61e7701db2eb868342c508a39'
RUN = 37954851017
EXPECTED = {(5000, n) for n in range(6, 30)} | {(1000, n) for n in range(1, 30)}
PREFIX = 'artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round28-cold044-final53-bfcc-20261009/'

def read(p):
    return json.loads(p.read_bytes())

def meta(p):
    b = p.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob': hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(b)).encode() + b'\0' + b).hexdigest()}

s = read(I / 'sealed/summary.json')
ch = read(I / 'intake-child.json')
t = read(I / 'intake/terminal.json')
progress = read(I / 'intake/progress.json')
official = read(I / 'official-original-selection.json')
bb = read(B / 'original-build-validation-attempt01/source-before.json')
assert ch['exit_code'] == t['exit_code'] == 0
assert t['records'] == t['expected'] == 106 and t['accepted_samples'] == 53
assert t['workload_executed'] is False
assert read(I / 'intake/whole-source-before.json') == read(I / 'intake/whole-source-after.json') == bb['source']
assert bb['source']['input_count'] == 1095 and len(bb['observer']['inputs']) == 5
assert s['source'] == official['source'] == bb['source']['source_commit'] == SOURCE
assert s['run_id'] == official['run_id'] == RUN and s['attempt'] == official['attempt'] == 1

oldp = B / 'validate-original-cold-shard.mixed26.py'
newp = B / 'validate-original-cold-shard.final53.py'
oldb = B / 'intake-next-mixed26.py'
newb = B / 'intake-next-final53.py'
old, new = oldp.read_text(), newp.read_text()
assert new == old.replace('increment-10k9-29-and-5k1-5/claim-input.json', 'increment-final-53/claim-input.json')
expected_batch = oldb.read_text().replace('NUM=7;', 'NUM=8;').replace('increment-10k9-29-and-5k1-5/', 'increment-final-53/').replace('validate-original-cold-shard.mixed26.py', 'validate-original-cold-shard.final53.py')
assert newb.read_text() == expected_batch
diff = ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(True), new.splitlines(True), fromfile=oldp.name, tofile=newp.name))
diff += ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(oldb.read_text().splitlines(True), newb.read_text().splitlines(True), fromfile=oldb.name, tofile=newb.name))
assert diff == (I / 'wrapper-path-adaptation.diff').read_text()
assert new.count('accepted=cold.validate_shard(dest,prior["outer"],prior["built"],binary,BUILD,ROOT)') == 1
# This is receipt review only. No original validator, ELF, ZIP decoder or CRC function is imported or executed.
assert 'data=z.read(i)' in new.replace(' ', '') or 'z.read(i)' in new

official_byid = {}
for slot in official['slots']:
    assert (slot['scale'], slot['repetition']) in EXPECTED
    job = slot['official_job']
    assert job['head_sha'] == SOURCE and job['run_id'] == RUN and job['run_attempt'] == 1
    assert job['status'] == 'completed' and job['conclusion'] == 'success'
    for a in slot['artifacts']:
        artifact = a['official']
        assert artifact['id'] not in official_byid
        official_byid[artifact['id']] = artifact
assert len(official_byid) == 106
byid = {p['artifact']['id']: p for p in progress}
assert len(byid) == len(progress) == 106 and set(byid) == set(official_byid)
originals = {x['artifact']['id']: x for x in s['originals']}
assert len(originals) == 106

for aid, pr in byid.items():
    a = official_byid[aid]
    assert pr['artifact'] == a == originals[aid]['artifact']
    assert a['workflow_run']['id'] == RUN and a['workflow_run']['head_sha'] == SOURCE
    assert pr['original_zip_bytes'] == a['size_in_bytes'] == originals[aid]['bytes']
    assert 'sha256:' + pr['original_zip_sha256'] == a['digest']
    assert pr['original_zip_sha256'] == originals[aid]['sha256']

rows = []
slots = set()
for m in s['samples']:
    aid = m['artifact_id']
    p = B / 'raw' / str(aid) / 'original-validation-attempt01'
    rec, out = read(p / 'receipt.json'), read(p / 'original-validate-shard-output.json')
    pr = byid[aid]
    before, after = read(p / 'inputs-before.json'), read(p / 'inputs-after.json')
    assert rec['exit_code'] == m['child_exit'] == pr['validator_child']['exit_code'] == 0
    assert rec['inputs_unchanged'] and rec['error'] is None
    assert pr['status'] == 'accepted_original_shard' and pr['sample_credit'] == 1
    assert before == after and before['source_commit'] == SOURCE
    assert before['observer'] == bb['observer'] and before['build_inventory'] == bb['build_inventory']
    assert before['zip'] == {'bytes': pr['original_zip_bytes'], 'sha256': pr['original_zip_sha256']}
    assert rec['run_id'] == RUN and rec['run_attempt'] == 1
    assert out['plan'] == m['plan'] and out['measurements'] == [m['sample']]
    assert out['study'] == m['study'] == {'protocol': 'p8-cold-only-study-v1', 'run_id': str(RUN), 'run_attempt': 1}
    plan = out['plan']
    assert plan['files'] == [m['scale']] and plan['stage_scope'] == 'cold_only_v1'
    assert plan['capacity_profile'] == 'scale_capacity_v1' and plan['dirty_budget'] == 200
    assert plan['repetitions'] == 30 and plan['deadline_ms'] == 18000000 and plan['max_output_bytes'] == 536870912
    assert plan['shard'] == {'count': 30, 'index': m['repetition']}
    slot = (m['scale'], m['repetition'])
    assert slot not in slots
    slots.add(slot)
    for file, key in [('receipt.json', 'receipt'), ('original-validate-shard-output.json', 'output')]:
        actual = meta(p / file)
        for k in ['bytes', 'sha256', 'git_blob']:
            assert actual[k] == m[key][k]
    rawdir = p.parent
    stdout, outer = read(rawdir / 'validator.stdout'), read(rawdir / 'validator-child.json')
    assert stdout == {'accepted': True, 'artifact_id': aid, 'scale': m['scale'], 'repetition': m['repetition'], 'samples': 1, 'source': SOURCE}
    assert (rawdir / 'validator.stderr').read_bytes() == b'' and outer == pr['validator_child']
    assert rec['argv'] == outer['argv'] and rec['accepted_samples'] == rec['accepted_shards'] == 1
    members = read(p / 'zip-members.json')
    assert len({x['path'] for x in members}) == len(members) and members
    assert all(type(x['crc32']) is int and 0 <= x['crc32'] <= 0xffffffff and len(x['sha256']) == 64 for x in members)
    rows.append({'artifact_id': aid, 'scale': slot[0], 'repetition': slot[1], 'child_exit': 0,
                 'receipt': meta(p / 'receipt.json'), 'output': meta(p / 'original-validate-shard-output.json'),
                 'stdout': meta(rawdir / 'validator.stdout'), 'stderr': meta(rawdir / 'validator.stderr'),
                 'child': meta(rawdir / 'validator-child.json'), 'original_crc_member_record': meta(p / 'zip-members.json'),
                 'original_member_count': len(members), 'official_zip_bytes': pr['original_zip_bytes'],
                 'official_zip_sha256': pr['original_zip_sha256'], 'source_observer_build_and_zip_before_after_equal': True})
assert slots == EXPECTED and len(rows) == 53
assert {(x['scale'], x['repetition']) for x in s['slots']} == EXPECTED
prior_slots = set()
for prior in ['increment-50k11-17', 'increment-50k18-23', 'increment-50k24-29-and-10k1-8', 'increment-10k9-29-and-5k1-5']:
    q = read(B / prior / 'sealed/summary.json')
    prior_slots |= {(x['plan']['files'][0], x['repetition']) for x in q['samples']}
assert not slots & prior_slots

assert (I / 'intake.stderr').read_bytes() == b''
outerlines = [json.loads(line) for line in (I / 'intake.stdout').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(outerlines) == 106
assert all(line == {'id': pr['artifact']['id'], 'status': pr['status'], 'sample_credit': pr['sample_credit'], 'error': None} for line, pr in zip(outerlines, progress))
capacity = [p for p in progress if '-capacity-' in p['artifact']['name']]
assert len(capacity) == 53
assert all(p['sample_credit'] == 0 and p['status'] == 'transport_verified_capacity_no_sample' and p['capacity_transport_only'] for p in capacity)
assert all(p['members'] and all(type(m['crc32']) is int and len(m['sha256']) == 64 for m in p['members']) for p in capacity)
assert s['accepted_union'] == 150 and s['new_accepted_samples'] == 53
assert s['published_before_this_increment'] is None and s['published_after_this_increment'] is None
assert s['registered_total'] == 150 and s['aggregate_or_workload_executed'] is False
assert s['new_build_validator_executions'] == 0 and s['original_shard_validator_executions'] == 53

manifest = read(I / 'all-113-leaf-upload-manifest.json')
tree = read(I / 'pure-additions-tree-elements.json')
server = read(I / 'connector-all-113-leaves-originals.json')
entries = manifest['entries']
assert len(entries) == len(tree['tree_elements']) == len(server['entries']) == 113
assert len({e['path'] for e in entries}) == 113
assert manifest['actual_publication_parent'] is None and tree['actual_base_tree'] is None
tree_map = {e['path']: e for e in tree['tree_elements']}
server_map = {e['expected_entry']['path']: e['server_receipt'] for e in server['entries']}
for e in entries:
    assert e['path'].startswith(PREFIX) and e['mode'] == '100644' and e['type'] == 'blob'
    assert tree_map[e['path']] == {k: e[k] for k in ['path', 'mode', 'type', 'sha']}
    sr = server_map[e['path']]
    assert sr['verified'] and sr['result'].get('isError') is False
    assert sr['server_oid'] == sr['result']['structuredContent']['sha'] == e['sha'] == sr['entry']['sha']
    assert sr['entry']['bytes'] == e['bytes'] and sr['entry']['sha256'] == e['sha256']
for x in originals.values():
    e = next(e for e in entries if e['path'] == x['repository_path'])
    assert (e['bytes'], e['sha256'], e['sha']) == (x['bytes'], x['sha256'], x['git_blob'])

report = {
    'schema': 'cold044-final53-independent-receipt-peer-v1', 'reviewer': '/root/execution_recon',
    'observed_at': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'verdict': 'accepted_scoped_53_original_receipts_and_113_uploaded_blob_mapping',
    'source': SOURCE, 'run_id': RUN, 'attempt': 1,
    'slots': [{'scale': a, 'repetition': b} for a, b in sorted(slots)],
    'original_validator_exits': [0] * 53, 'new_build_validator_executions': 0,
    'original_build_reused': '9aba8f01e5f5766ac55f3ebed1ff21991dcb6cdb',
    'source_boundary': {'products': 1095, 'original_observers': 5, 'whole_source_before_after_equal_original_build': True,
                        'each_observer_build_and_original_zip_before_after_equal': True,
                        'original_ELF_sha256': '09ef70915331298bbb2fcda3e2526a89757c1385ef3c8e7926c39c73bf8ecdae'},
    'wrapper_changes': 'Only batch 7 to 8, new ledger/output paths and final53 wrapper filename. Original validator call and original drivers unchanged.',
    'archive_review': {'original_zip_count': 106, 'capacity_credit': 0, 'official_size_and_digest_vs_original_receipt_equal': True,
                       'original_member_CRC_and_SHA_records_read': True, 'archive_CRC_or_zip_bytes_reexecution': False,
                       'uploaded_leaf_count': 113, 'all_server_OIDs_match_frozen_tree_elements': True,
                       'actual_publication_parent': None, 'actual_commit_or_pure_A_diff_not_yet_observed': True},
    'counts': {'new_locally_verified_originals': 53, 'previous_accepted_union': 97, 'accepted_union': 150,
               'durable_before_this_pending_publication': None, 'durable_after_this_pending_publication': None,
               'concurrent_publication_accounting': 'Root tracks actual commits and independent owner-six recovery', 'registered_population': 150, 'aggregate_gate_reviewed_here': False},
    'scope': 'Read original 53 child receipts/stdout/stderr, complete outputs and before/after snapshots; original official ZIP digest/size and member CRC records; compare pure new-prefix tree request and all 113 server OIDs. No validator, ELF, CRC, archive or workload rerun. No new source or budget changes; no publication performed.',
    'references': {str(p.relative_to(I)): meta(p) for p in [I/'sealed/summary.json', I/'intake-child.json', I/'intake/terminal.json', I/'intake.stdout', I/'intake.stderr', I/'official-original-selection.json', I/'wrapper-path-adaptation.diff', I/'all-113-leaf-upload-manifest.json', I/'pure-additions-tree-elements.json', I/'connector-all-113-leaves-originals.json']},
    'wrapper_sources': [meta(p) for p in [oldp, newp, oldb, newb]], 'rows': rows,
    'newly_completed_todos': 0, 'remaining_todos': 29,
}
(O / 'independent-review.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(meta(O / 'independent-review.json')))
